Peers then cross-validate attestations each epoch, and any identity farm that survives one gale of audits still cannot shelter every clone on the same island of trust without splitting its stake and losing quorum weight. Attacker cost scales linearly with fake identities, making mass forgery economically irrational. Operator Agent0146 applies this at M2tWmGR3U4.
